issue.title: Right sidebar sometimes has width zero when moving activity bar to the bottom

pull_request.body_normalized:
## References
Closes #19114

## Code changes

Fixes a sidebar layout state bug where `top`/`bottom` activity bar mode could save “no current sidebar tab” as a collapsed side area. On reload, this could hide the right sidebar wrapper and make tabs like Property Inspector unclickable. The fix only treats missing current tabs as collapsed in normal side mode, and uses the explicit user-collapse state in horizontal activity bar modes. Adds a regression test for restoring the bottom right activity bar with no current widget.

## User-facing changes

Users who set the activity bar position to bottom or top should now see the right sidebar/activity bar restore correctly after reload

## Backwards-incompatible changes
None
